scope: First design concept only, not implementation

prompts.prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop landing-page HERO BAND for In Bloom, a real flower studio in Astana. This is one normal 1536×1024 viewport, NOT a full-page miniature, no browser or device frame.
Input 1 is the authentic In Bloom logo: preserve its handmade lettering and flower mark, coral on olive. Inputs 2–3 are STYLE REFERENCES only: dimensional floral presence, editorial scale, fine botanical outlines; never their words, statistics, branding or page layout. Input 4 is the actual Pink bouquet: isolate the FLOWERS and wrapping from the selfie/background, preserve their identity; no person.
The relationship: lush, tactile bouquet abundance draws attention, then resolves into a calm readable invitation to choose a bouquet or talk to a florist. Warm artistic local studio, expressive and approachable. Use sampled olive #787937, coral #E89F94, warm cream #FAF4DF and deep olive; sophisticated Cyrillic editorial serif, restrained italic accents, clear sans-serif controls. Choose composition and geometry freely; generous air and beautiful photographic depth. Keep the bouquet enormous and tangible without obscuring copy.
Show only authentic logo, navigation “Букеты”, “О студии”, “Как заказать”, “Контакты”, “WhatsApp”; headline “Цветы, которые говорят за вас.”; supporting line “Букеты в Астане — для больших чувств и маленьких поводов.”; primary action “Выбрать букет”; secondary “Написать флористу”.
Single root header. The emotional opening will lead into a calmer cream showcase later, but show NONE of that later content here. Avoid invented service promises or badges, decorative text illegibility, and card-heavy generic templates. One polished coherent image, no watermark.

Create the next full-width desktop SCROLL BAND for the In Bloom landing, a readable 1536×1024 product-showcase viewport. This is a HEADERLESS continuation, not another hero or a full-page thumbnail. Use four input images as actual product identity references, in order: Cloud, White bloom, Soft s, Sophie basket S. Preserve the supplied bouquet compositions, flowers, colors and wrapping; show the flowers cleanly without the selfie people/backgrounds.
The visual system is warm artistic In Bloom: olive #787937, coral #E89F94, warm cream #FAF4DF, dark olive text; expressive elegant Cyrillic serif headings, selective italic accents, neutral readable sans for names, prices and buttons. The preceding olive emotional introduction resolves here into a calm cream space where four bouquets can be compared easily. Organic botanical linework can quietly connect the choices. Composition, framing and card shapes are yours; each photo must be large and distinct, with an obvious associated price and action.
Exact visible copy: “Витрина букетов”; “Выберите настроение. Остальное обсудим в WhatsApp.” Product pairs: “Cloud” — “18 700 ₸”; “White bloom” — “13 200 ₸”; “Soft s” — “10 700 ₸”; “Sophie basket S” — “12 100 ₸”. Each has “Заказать в WhatsApp”. One catalogue exit: “Больше букетов”.
No header, logo restart, basket icons, cart, checkout, product badges, invented delivery claims or extra products. No foreign reference branding. Four comparable flowers, their exact labels and clear actions are the focus; allow generous editorial air without tiny text. One coherent polished UI image, no frame or watermark.

Create the closing 1536×1024 desktop SCROLL BAND of an In Bloom flower-studio landing. Headerless continuation; no second navigation or hero. The input is the real logo; keep its handmade coral letterforms and flower mark as brand identity. Olive #787937, coral #E89F94, cream #FAF4DF and deep olive. Continue expressive Cyrillic serif headings, limited italic accents and readable sans body. After a cream bouquet-selection section this band brings the visitor into a warmer personal conversation and then practical local contact. Change composition rhythm: expressive typography and quiet botanical contour accents, modest imagery, compact functional close. Choose grouping, geometry and proportions freely, with readable UI scale.
Allowlisted exact copy:
“Цветы с характером.”
“Дофаминовые букеты, редкая экзотика и понятная классика — в In Bloom.”
“Не нашли свой букет?”
“Напишите нам о поводе и пожеланиях.”
Action “Обсудить букет”.
“How to order” section in Russian: “Как заказать”, “Выберите букет”, “Напишите в WhatsApp”, “Согласуйте детали”.
Contact section: “Заходите за цветами”; “Астана, проспект Женис, 8/1”; “Доставка по Астане”; “Стоимость и время доставки уточняйте в WhatsApp.”; “+7 708 220 46 75”; “Открыть в 2ГИС”; “Instagram”; “inbloom.flower.ast”; “WhatsApp”.
Use only this content and the supplied logo. No invented business hours, reviews, delivery promises, badges, extra services, staff portraits or fake maps. Do not make repeated cards or another giant bouquet hero. One coherent polished closing band, no device frame or watermark.

Use case: compositing. Create ONE complete continuous desktop landing page from the three reviewed source images, in this exact top-to-bottom order: 1. olive In Bloom hero and single header; 2. cream four-bouquet showcase; 3. olive studio/custom-enquiry, ordering steps and contacts.
Target one tall authored full-page canvas 1536×3072 pixels (preferred), retaining the full width and readable UI scale of all three sources. This is an assembly of existing design, not a new design.
Preserve the source section order, logo, typography, photographs, botanical artwork, exact Russian text, bouquet names, price values, buttons, phone number, address and Instagram handle. Each source section appears once. Keep the intentional olive/cream/olive section changes. Change only joins/background continuity and duplicated continuation whitespace. Retain one root header and the complete closing contact section.
The four exact product-price associations must survive: Cloud 18 700 ₸; White bloom 13 200 ₸; Soft s 10 700 ₸; Sophie basket S 12 100 ₸. Contacts must survive: Астана, проспект Женис, 8/1; +7 708 220 46 75; inbloom.flower.ast.
No new sections, rewritten copy, removed labels, fake claims, repeated hero, device frame or watermark. Do not squeeze the page into a normal landscape viewport. Preserve the reviewed designs, making only the declared joins.

Create ONE mobile first-viewport design of this same In Bloom landing, target portrait 1024×1792 pixels, no phone frame or browser chrome.
Input 1 is the accepted desktop hero VISUAL ANCHOR. Preserve the exact In Bloom logo identity, olive/coral/cream system, expressive serif/sans hierarchy, supplied Pink bouquet identity and the same customer message. It may determine those shared assets and visual roles; it must NOT force desktop geometry. Input 2 is the authentic logo for fidelity.
Change ONLY the responsive allocation into a comfortable mobile opening: natural reading order, readable headline, generous touch-sized actions, a large tactile view of the SAME bouquet without obscuring text, compact mobile header. Navigation can collapse into a familiar menu icon; do not list all desktop navigation at tiny scale. Root brand appears once. Composition and bouquet crop can adapt to portrait, without inventing another floral arrangement or extra sections.
Exact copy: “Цветы, которые говорят за вас.”; “Букеты в Астане — для больших чувств и маленьких поводов.”; “Выбрать букет”; “Написать флористу”; optional compact header label “WhatsApp”.
Keep olive #787937, coral #E89F94, cream #FAF4DF and deep olive. Preserve the beautiful source floral depth and restrained botanical contour accents. No product list, prices, later contact footer, checkout, stock badge or service claim here. This output tests the mobile hero only, not an entire page squeezed into a phone. One polished readable portrait UI image, no collage or watermark.
